messages:
alice: Hey team — noticed Feb committed GPU reservation costs are attributed to `ml-platform-prod` rather than `vision-team`. billing export shows label inheritance from a parent folder (project-ops). Anyone else seeing this?

ben: I saw a spike on ml-platform this morning, thought it was autoscaler churn. Can you paste the query you used? :eyes:

alice: Sure, pulling from billing export in BigQuery. Quick query I used:```sql
SELECT invoice_month, labels.key AS label_key, labels.value AS label_value, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_export_v1.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`, UNNEST(labels) AS labels
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-02' AND service.description LIKE '%Compute Engine%'
GROUP BY invoice_month, label_key, label_value
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
```

carla: That's the classic folder->project label inheritance. Some projects failed to set `team` label so the billing exporter fell back to the folder-level label `ml-platform-prod`. Means chargeback routing is wrong. We need to backfill project labels and fix the tagger.

dmitri: We should be careful about retroactive chargeback. Finance needs a formal delta calculation before we reassign costs. I'll open a finance ticket. Also propose we enforce a TagPolicy in infra modules to prevent unlabeled projects.

alice: I put together a tiny backfill/dry-run script for k8s/GCE assets:```bash
# list instances without team label
gcloud compute instances list --filter='-labels.team:*' --format='csv(name,zone,labels)' > unlabeled_instances.csv
# for k8s nodes
kubectl get nodes -L team -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,TEAM:.metadata.labels.team > nodes_with_team.csv
```
Dry-run produces CSV we can review.

ben: Can we do a dry-run + team sign-off before applying? Risk of mislabeling leads to incorrect chargebacks. Suggest we produce a mapping CSV and post to the finance slack channel for approvals. I'll add an alert in Datadog for folder-label drift. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Incident created: billing-mismatch-194812345 (FIN-452) — ticket opened with finance linking BigQuery export + sample rows. <https://tickets.company/FIN-452|FIN-452>

carla: I'll run the backfill dry-run tomorrow 2026-03-19 09:00 PT and tag the affected project owners. @dmitri please confirm when ticket FIN-452 is ready so we can present the delta. Also updating our terraform module: set default `labels = { team = var.team }` and add a validation rule.

dmitri: FIN-452 created and I added the requested cost delta calculation (csv + SQL). Finance asked for proof we won't double-credit; they'll review. I'll CC @ben and the billing owner.

alice: Estimated cost impact ~ $12,300 for Feb shifting from vision-team -> ml-platform-prod. If finance won't re-bill, options: absorb, credits, or manual chargeback. Ben — can you confirm reserved commitment mapping isn't the cause?

ben: Checked reserved commitments mapping — looks fine. This is pure invoice attribution (labels). I submitted a PR to the tagger service to prefer project-level `team` label before falling back to folder-level. Link to PR: <https://git.company/repo/tagger/pulls/278|pr-278>. Planning to rollout after dry-run approval.

dmitri: Good. Plan: run dry-run, get owners sign-off, present FIN-452 to finance, run backfill only after approval, and push terraform guardrails. I'll document postmortem + remediation steps in GH. Reassigning this thread to `eng-infra` ops async.

alice: Thanks — tagging notes: action items -> (1) carla run dry-run, (2) ben add alert & review PR, (3) dmitri own finance ticket, (4) alice produce final delta CSV.
